title: Integrated circuits, wafers fabricated in South Korea, packed in China
description: Twelve-inch wafers are made and given their complete circuit in South Korea, then bumped, diced and flip-chip packed in China. CBP held South Korea (N333934): front-end fabrication decides.
notes: One of the six families added in D660 (semiconductor devices). Built from CBP's facts into a development fixture; plant capabilities, duty rates, import value and group costs are illustrative placeholders, not sourced. The ruling itself is excluded from precedent search. Picked by family, not by result. Recorded development run (eval/results/plan-integrated-circuit-2023-local-verifier-v2-d660-litellm.json): the engine agreed with CBP on South Korea at 0.98 stated. The shown plan moves the bare wafers and front-end fabrication to China, check 0.95 on N333677; that ruling held the United States for a pressure sensor whose die was made there. It supports front-end fabrication deciding, but it is a sensor, not an integrated circuit: partial. A run on this site is a new run and may differ.
